summary: Braiin Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a non-binding term sheet to acquire a 50.1% majority interest in Cumbria Capital Ltd (parent of Home.cc) for approximately GBP 3.85 million in growth capital plus Braiin equity securities, implying a pre-money valuation of ~GBP 35 million. The deal is subject to due diligence, definitive documentation, shareholder and Nasdaq approvals. No board recommendation or advisors named. The non-binding nature and conditions create execution risk; watch for definitive agreement and regulatory timeline.
